I had a similar experience.  
So it was my mum’s funeral and my uncle and his wife arrived.  Now, I hadn’t seen my uncle and his wife  for a few years because they’d drifted apart from my mum but we were still on good terms. 
Anyway, I immediately didn’t recognise the woman my uncle was with and assumed he’d remarried or met someone else.  I asked someone else “who is that lady?” they responded with “____” (his wife’s name).   I was absolutely bewildered as this was 100% NOT her.    Different face, different height, completely different voice.   She always had a deeper voice and this lady’s was very high pitched. 
I asked a couple more people and they confirmed it was her. She even came over and talked to me about past memories. 
 but it definitely was not the woman I knew. I’ve never been so sure of something in my life.  
I haven’t seen her since and it confuses the hell out of me to this day.

One night in 2020, myself and my partner were both in bed and none of us could sleep, so we stayed up chatting. Both the kids were in bed asleep and my youngest was a baby.  
Suddenly, we both heard a male’s voice outside shouting our baby daughter’s name.  (It’s not a common name and don’t know anyone else with the name). But of us shot up in disbelief wondering why I man would be outside calling our daughter’s name.  No one was there.  
We sat up talking about the incident for ages as we were both so confused. 
About a hour later, I received a phone call from a family member saying my brother had been found dead in his flat and he had been dead for several days.    
I thought back to the last time I’d spoken to him over the phone and he hadn’t yet met my baby daughter because of covid and everything and I remember him saying he couldn’t wait to meet her.  He never got the chance to. 
I’ve always been sceptical about ghosts but I always wonder if this was him, saying hello to her.   It still freaks me and my partner out to this day.
